parameters.jsCode:
// Generate images with 3 fallback providers (all free, no API key)
// 1. Pollinations.ai  2. HuggingFace FLUX.1  3. FFmpeg gradient (always works)
const { exec, execSync } = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const scriptData = $input.first().json;
const prompts = scriptData.imagePrompts || [];
if (prompts.length === 0) throw new Error('No image prompts found');

const tmpDir = '/tmp/n8n_images_' + Date.now();
fs.mkdirSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true });

try {
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'prompts.json'), JSON.stringify(prompts));

  const script = [
    "const https = require('https');",
    "const http = require('http');",
    "const { execSync } = require('child_process');",
    "const fs = require('fs');",
    "const path = require('path');",
    "const tmpDir = process.argv[2];",
    "const prompts = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'prompts.json'), 'utf8'));",
    "const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));",
    "",
    "function httpReq(url, opts) {",
    "  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {",
    "    const u = new URL(url);",
    "    const mod = u.protocol === 'http:' ? http : https;",
    "    const method = (opts&&opts.method)||'GET';",
    "    const headers = (opts&&opts.headers)||{};",
    "    const body = opts&&opts.body;",
    "    const maxR = (opts&&opts.maxR!==undefined)?opts.maxR:10;",
    "    const tout = (opts&&opts.timeout)||120000;",
    "    const r = mod.request({hostname:u.hostname,port:u.port,path:u.pathname+u.search,method,headers:{'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0',...headers}}, res => {",
    "      if (res.statusCode>=300 && res.statusCode<400 && res.headers.location) {",
    "        if (maxR<=0){reject(new Error('Too many redirects'));return;}",
    "        const loc = res.headers.location.startsWith('http')?res.headers.location:u.protocol+'//'+u.hostname+res.headers.location;",
    "        httpReq(loc,{...opts,maxR:maxR-1}).then(resolve).catch(reject);return;",
    "      }",
    "      const chunks=[];",
    "      res.on('data',c=>chunks.push(c));",
    "      res.on('end',()=>resolve({status:res.statusCode,headers:res.headers,body:Buffer.concat(chunks)}));",
    "    });",
    "    r.on('error',reject);",
    "    r.setTimeout(tout,()=>{r.destroy();reject(new Error('Timeout'));});",
    "    if(body)r.write(body);",
    "    r.end();",
    "  });",
    "}",
    "",
    "// Provider 1: Pollinations.ai",
    "async function tryPollinations(prompt) {",
    "  const url='https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/'+encodeURIComponent(prompt)+'?width=768&height=1344&nologo=true&seed='+(Date.now());",
    "  const res=await httpReq(url,{timeout:120000});",
    "  if(res.status!==200) throw new Error('Poll HTTP '+res.status);",
    "  const ct=(res.headers['content-type']||'').toLowerCase();",
    "  if(!ct.includes('image')||res.body.length<5000) throw new Error('Poll: not image (ct='+ct+',sz='+res.body.length+')');",
    "  return res.body;",
    "}",
    "",
    "// Provider 2: HuggingFace FLUX.1-merged (known working params)",
    "async function tryHuggingFace(prompt) {",
    "  const HF='multimodalart-flux-1-merged.hf.space';",
    "  const payload=JSON.stringify({data:[prompt,0,true,768,1344,3.5,4]});",
    "  const sub=await httpReq('https://'+HF+'/gradio_api/call/infer',{",
    "    method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':''+Buffer.byteLength(payload)},body:payload,timeout:30000",
    "  });",
    "  if(sub.status!==200) throw new Error('HF submit '+sub.status);",
    "  const j=JSON.parse(sub.body.toString());",
    "  if(!j.event_id) throw new Error('HF no event_id');",
    "  const sseRes=await httpReq('https://'+HF+'/gradio_api/call/infer/'+j.event_id,{timeout:120000});",
    "  const sse=sseRes.body.toString();",
    "  if(sse.includes('event: error')||sse.includes('event:error')) throw new Error('HF Space error');",
    "  const lines=sse.split('\\n');",
    "  let ds=null;",
    "  for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){",
    "    if(lines[i].includes('complete')){",
    "      for(let k=i+1;k<lines.length;k++){if(lines[k].startsWith('data:')){ds=lines[k].substring(5).trim();break;}}",
    "      break;",
    "    }",
    "  }",
    "  if(!ds) throw new Error('HF no complete');",
    "  const p=JSON.parse(ds);",
    "  const imgUrl=p[0]&&p[0].url;",
    "  if(!imgUrl) throw new Error('HF no URL');",
    "  const imgRes=await httpReq(imgUrl,{timeout:60000});",
    "  if(imgRes.status!==200||imgRes.body.length<5000) throw new Error('HF bad download');",
    "  return imgRes.body;",
    "}",
    "",
    "// Provider 3: FFmpeg gradient (always works, local)",
    "function generateGradient(idx) {",
    "  const colors=['#1a1a2e','#16213e','#0f3460','#533483','#2b2d42','#264653','#2a9d8f','#e76f51'];",
    "  const c=colors[idx%colors.length];",
    "  const out=path.join(tmpDir,'grad_'+idx+'.png');",
    "  execSync('ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i \"color=c='+c+':s=768x1344:d=1\" -frames:v 1 \"'+out+'\"',{timeout:10000});",
    "  return fs.readFileSync(out);",
    "}",
    "",
    "const providers = [",
    "  {name:'Pollinations', fn:tryPollinations, retries:2, retryDelay:10000, betweenDelay:3000},",
    "  {name:'HuggingFace', fn:tryHuggingFace, retries:2, retryDelay:15000, betweenDelay:20000},",
    "];",
    "",
    "async function genImage(prompt, idx) {",
    "  for (const prov of providers) {",
    "    for (let a=0; a<prov.retries; a++) {",
    "      try {",
    "        if(a>0){process.stderr.write('    '+prov.name+' retry '+a+'\\n');await sleep(prov.retryDelay);}",
    "        const img=await prov.fn(prompt);",
    "        process.stderr.write('  #'+(idx+1)+' OK via '+prov.name+' ('+img.length+' bytes)\\n');",
    "        return {base64:img.toString('base64'),provider:prov.name};",
    "      } catch(e) {",
    "        process.stderr.write('    '+prov.name+'['+a+']: '+e.message.substring(0,120)+'\\n');",
    "      }",
    "    }",
    "  }",
    "  process.stderr.write('  #'+(idx+1)+' using gradient fallback\\n');",
    "  const img=generateGradient(idx);",
    "  return {base64:img.toString('base64'),provider:'gradient'};",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function main() {",
    "  const res=[];",
    "  let lastProvider=null;",
    "  for(let i=0;i<prompts.length;i++) {",
    "    if(i>0 && lastProvider) {",
    "      const prov=providers.find(p=>p.name===lastProvider);",
    "      const delay=prov?prov.betweenDelay:3000;",
    "      await sleep(delay);",
    "    }",
    "    process.stderr.write('Image '+(i+1)+'/'+prompts.length+'\\n');",
    "    const result=await genImage(prompts[i],i);",
    "    lastProvider=result.provider;",
    "    res.push(result.base64);",
    "  }",
    "  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(res));",
    "}",
    "main().catch(e=>{process.stderr.write('FATAL: '+e.message.substring(0,500)+'\\n');process.exit(1);});"
  ];

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'generate.js'), script.join('\n'));

  const output = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    exec(
      `node "${path.join(tmpDir, 'generate.js')}" "${tmpDir}"`,
      { timeout: 900000, maxBuffer: 100 * 1024 * 1024 },
      (error, stdout, stderr) => {
        if (error) {
          const fm = (stderr||'').match(/FATAL: ([\s\S]+)/);
          const tail = (stderr||'').split('\n').filter(l=>l.trim()).slice(-5).join(' | ');
          reject(new Error(fm ? fm[1].trim() : tail || error.message));
        } else {
          resolve(stdout);
        }
      }
    );
  });

  const imageBase64Array = JSON.parse(output);

  return {
    json: {
      imageBase64Array,
      imageCount: imageBase64Array.length,
      script: scriptData.script,
      title: scriptData.title,
      description: scriptData.description,
      tags: scriptData.tags
    }
  };
} finally {
  try { fs.rmSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch(e) {}
}
